notes.title: 開発チームからの伝言
20210210—Love in the distance Important update of game plot
notes.notes:
Hello players,thank you very much for your support and valuable suggestions.We have optimized for the following problems.

Introduction:
1. The specific options in important chapters have been revised and the relevant plot content has been expanded.
2. Open a new chapter: Chapter-9.
3. Reduce the waiting time of input for some chapters.

Because of the mistakes in the script design, we have brought you a bad gaming experience in recent days. We are deeply sorry.
We hope that the rationality and completeness of the game story will be improved by this update. And we will continue to pay attention to the feedback from players for improving the game experience.

notes.title: 20210209-Love in the distance Support Backstage operation
notes.notes:
Hello players,thank you very much for your support and valuable suggestions.

Game has been supported Backstage operation.

We are deeply sorry for the inconvenient game experience, we will always pay attention to the feedback from players and optimize the game.

notes.title: 20210206- Love in the distance has completed the chapter acceleration function
notes.notes:
Hello players,thank you very much for your support of the game "Long Distance Love" and your valuable suggestions.

We have optimized the following problems.

Introduction:
1. The problem of "waiting for input for too long"
To ensure the complete experience of game play, this function will only be enabled in the completed chapters.
Implemented by "Ctrl" key ,which can be accelerated continuously by long pressing.

2. Game full screen
Implemented by Alt+Enter

We are deeply sorry for the inconvenient game experience, we will always pay attention to the feedback from players and optimize the game.
